stem.en: Use the 2n² rule. What is the largest number of electrons the N-shell (n = 4) can hold when it is not the outermost shell?

explanation.en: 2 × n² = 2 × 4² = 2 × 16 = 32. If you got 64, you multiplied 2 × 4 first and then squared: square n first. If you said 8, that is the limit for an outermost shell, and this question says N is not the outermost.

hints.en: Square n first, then multiply by 2. The limit of 8 applies only to an outermost shell.
